create_arkit_dataset: create an ArkitScene dataset instance with train split and custom resolution for ARKit scene loading
load_arkit_scenes: load all ARKit scenes from a base directory into the dataset for training or validation
get_camera_intrinsics: get the camera intrinsic matrix from a pincam file for a specific video and frame
get_camera_pose: get the camera pose matrix for a given frame id from trajectory data
convert_traj_to_matrix: convert a space-delimited trajectory string into rotation and translation matrices using Rodrigues formula
